text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There were no reports of overdose in the TESTIM clinical trials. There is a single report in the literature of acute overdosage after injection of testosterone enanthate. This subject had serum testosterone concentrations of up to 11,400 ng/dL, which were implicated in a cerebrovascular accident. Treatment of overdosage would consist of discontinuation of TESTIM, washing the application site with soap and water, and appropriate symptomatic and supportive care.
